servers.name: Playwright
servers.description: Browser automation for inspecting pages, driving UI flows, and validating web app behavior.
servers.setupNotes: Runs the Microsoft Playwright MCP package through npx. It can open and control browser sessions for the active workspace.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.description: Repository, issue, pull request, Actions, release, and code security workflows.
servers.setupNotes: Official GitHub remote MCP. Authenticate in the target client, or use a custom PAT-backed setup if your client does not support OAuth.

servers.name: Context7
servers.description: Developer documentation lookup for libraries and frameworks.
servers.setupNotes: Runs a third-party package through npx and may need network access.

servers.name: OpenAI Docs
servers.description: Official OpenAI documentation lookup for API, Codex, and ChatGPT integration work.
servers.setupNotes: Uses the official remote OpenAI documentation MCP endpoint.

servers.name: Vercel
servers.description: Project, deployment, log, and team context for Vercel-hosted applications.
servers.setupNotes: Official remote Vercel MCP. It can expose deployment and project data; grant the narrowest Vercel access that fits the workspace.

servers.name: Railway
servers.description: Project, service, deployment, environment, variable, and domain management for Railway.
servers.setupNotes: Official remote Railway MCP. It can manage infrastructure, so enable it only for workspaces that should operate Railway projects.

servers.name: Supabase
servers.description: Project-scoped Supabase database, auth, storage, functions, and documentation workflows.
servers.setupNotes: Official remote Supabase MCP. Use Supabase's project scoping and read-only options where possible before granting write access.

servers.name: Sentry
servers.description: Production error, trace, performance, and release investigation through Sentry.
servers.setupNotes: Requires Sentry authentication in the target client. Production event data may include user or request details.

servers.name: Grafana
servers.description: Metrics, logs, dashboards, incidents, and alerting context from Grafana.
servers.setupNotes: Requires uvx, GRAFANA_URL, and GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN in the agent environment. Prefer a read-only service account unless write tools are needed.

servers.name: Linear
servers.description: Issue, project, comment, team, and roadmap workflows for Linear.
servers.setupNotes: Official remote Linear MCP. Use restricted API keys or read-only access when the workflow does not need issue mutations.

servers.name: Atlassian
servers.description: Jira, Confluence, and Compass search, summarization, issue, and page workflows.
servers.setupNotes: Official Atlassian Rovo MCP endpoint. The older /v1/sse endpoint is deprecated after 2026-06-30.

servers.name: Figma
servers.description: Design context, variables, components, Code Connect, and write-to-canvas workflows.
servers.setupNotes: Official remote Figma MCP. Figma currently allows only clients listed in its MCP catalog.

servers.name: Notion
servers.description: Workspace page, database, comment, and team knowledge workflows in Notion.
servers.setupNotes: Official hosted Notion MCP. Workspace permissions come from the account and integration authorization in the target client.

servers.name: Stripe
servers.description: Stripe API and knowledge-base access for payments, billing, customers, and subscriptions.
servers.setupNotes: Official Stripe MCP. Treat as high-risk because payment/customer data and write-capable API actions may be available.

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.description: Live web, local, news, image, video, and LLM-context search through Brave Search.
servers.setupNotes: Requires BRAVE_API_KEY in the agent environment. Search results are fetched from Brave's API.
